curriculum_scope: LKS Cyber Security 2026 / NIST SP 800-115 / WorldSkills Skill 54

vulnerability.title: Rust Mutable Borrowing and Reference Semantic Violation
vulnerability.root_cause: The function decrypt attempts to mutate a borrowed buffer via push_str while the parameter is typed as an immutable reference (&String) and the caller binds the variable as immutable without &mut passing.
vulnerability.impact: Compilation abort (error[E0596] & error[E0308]); program cannot build or execute until ownership and borrowing rules are satisfied.

remediation.primary: Enforce explicit mutable borrowing contracts by typing parameters as &mut String, binding mutable variables via let mut, and passing mutable references &mut var.
remediation.standard: Rust API Guidelines / RFC 2094 Non-Lexical Lifetimes

vulnerability.title: Rust AST Statement Termination and Macro Format Malformation
vulnerability.root_cause: Omission of statement terminator semicolon (;), non-existent control keyword (ret; instead of return;), and malformed format specifier string (":?" lacking {} placeholder) in println!.
vulnerability.impact: Immediate compiler rejection due to grammar parsing and compile-time macro parameter validation failures.

remediation.primary: Adopt automated rustfmt code formatting, compiler diagnostic analysis, and standard std::fmt Display ({}) and Debug ({:?}) placeholder syntax.

vulnerability.title: PNG Extensible Metadata Exposure and Spatial Interleaved RGBA LSB Steganography
vulnerability.root_cause: Cleartext acrostic instruction embedded within PNG tEXt metadata chunk ('CHECK LSB') and unencrypted Base64 payload encoded across the lowest bit of all 4 color channels (RGBA) without cryptographic secrecy.
vulnerability.impact: Extraction of confidential payload via trivial scanline defiltering and LSB bit extraction without requiring authentication or secret keys.

remediation.primary: Implement automated metadata scrubbing (exiftool/image reprocessing) and apply statistical chi-square steganalysis and data loss prevention (DLP) monitoring.
